title: Cutout rig data (schemaVersion 1)
description: Envelope `data` for documents of type `rig`. Structure only; semantic checks (cycles, references, key order) run in the C++ core.

length.description: Bone length in px along its local +x (plugin 1.5.0; 0/absent = point bone). Drawn by the editor; the two-bone IK effector when the lower bone has no explicit tip.

color.description: Editor-only display colour (#rrggbb or #rrggbbaa). Ignored by runtimes.

slots.description: Array order is draw order, back to front.

attachments.description: Default attachments. An active skin is looked up first, then this list.

skins.description: Outfit/variant sets (plugin 1.2.0): provide or override attachments by (slot, name). Clips keep keying names.

expressions.description: Named facial/pose sets (plugin 1.2.0), applied after track 0 and before layer tracks 1..15.

slots.description: slot id -> attachment name, or null to hide the slot.

bones.description: bone id -> absolute channel values (unlisted channels keep animating).

ik.description: IK constraints (plugin 1.3.0), solved after the expression layer on world transforms in `order` (then array order). Semantics in docs/contract.md.

bones.description: 1 bone = aim (local +x axis at the target); 2 = two-bone limb, parent then its direct child (effector = `tip`, else the child's length tip, else its first child bone); 3..32 (plugin 1.13.0) = a chain, each bone the direct child of the previous one, solved by FABRIK (same effector rule on the last bone).

target.description: Bone whose world origin the chain reaches; never in the chain or below it.

tip.description: Explicit effector of chains of 2+ (plugin 1.4.0): a direct child of the last bone. Absent = the last bone's length tip, else its first child.

aimAxis.description: Aim chains (plugin 1.4.1): the bone-local direction, in degrees (0 = +x, 90 = +y / down the screen), that points at the target. Absent = 0. Two-bone chains: ANIM_IK_AIM_AXIS.

stretch.description: Plugin 1.13.0: an unreachable target scales the chain along its bones' length axis (aim: the bone's scaleX; 2+ bones: the first bone's scaleX), blended by mix. Needs every chain bone to have a length (else ANIM_IK_STRETCH_LENGTH, no-op); aim chains only with aimAxis 0.

compress.description: Plugin 1.13.0, aim chains: a target closer than the bone's length shrinks it onto the target.

uniform.description: Plugin 1.13.0: stretch/compress scale y as well.

physics.description: Physics constraints (plugin 1.13.0, Spine 4.2-like, presentation only): a bone trails its animated pose (after IK) through a fixed-step spring-damper. Semantics, determinism and reset rules in docs/contract.md.

x.description: Channel mix 0..1: world x offset of the origin.

y.description: Channel mix 0..1: world y offset of the origin.

rotate.description: Channel mix 0..1: turn about the origin (lever = the bone length, 50 px for point bones).

scaleX.description: Channel mix 0..1: stretch along the bone's x axis.

inertia.description: 0..1 (default 1): how much of the parents' motion the bone lags behind.

strength.description: Spring toward the animated pose, 1/s² per unit mass (default 100).

limit.description: px/s: motion faster than this pushes the bone no harder (default 5000).

teleport.description: px: an input origin jump larger than this within one step settles the bone instead of flinging it (default 300).

resetOnStart.description: Settle when a clip starts on the base track (track 0).

events.description: Event definitions (plugin 1.8.0, Spine-like). Optional; once present every clip event key must name one. int/float/string are the default payload of its keys; audio names an audio asset a host may play when the event fires. Presentation only: never a controller binding signal.

audio.description: Audio asset id (kind audio, checked by the service).

target.description: bone:<id>, slot:<id>, rig (property expression, step keys of expression ids / null), ik:<id> (mix 0..1, bendPositive step bool) or physics:<id> (plugin 1.13.0, mix 0..1).

property.description: sequence (plugin 1.12.0): slot tracks picking frames of the slot's sequence attachment (step keys {mode, index, delay}).

attachment.description: Deform tracks (plugin 1.4.0): the slot's mesh attachment whose vertices the keys offset.

offsets.description: Deform keys (plugin 1.4.0): dx, dy per mesh vertex in image pixels, added to the setup vertices.

mode.description: Sequence keys (plugin 1.12.0): hold shows `index`; the others advance one frame per `delay` ms from the key (Spine SequenceMode). Default hold.

index.description: Sequence keys: the frame the key starts at (0-based; reverse modes count from the last frame).

interp.description: Segment from this key to the next. Default linear; attachment keys are always step.

curve.description: Bezier handles [x1, y1, x2, y2] for interp bezier, normalized to the segment: x = fraction of segment time, y = fraction of the value change (may overshoot).

editor.description: Non-essential authoring metadata (view). Ignored by runtimes. Bone display colours live on the bones (`color`, plugin 1.5.0).

type.description: region (default: the image rectangle), mesh (plugin 1.4.0) or clipping (plugin 1.12.0: no picture; the slots after it through `end` draw only inside its polygon). Semantics in docs/contract.md.

vertices.description: Mesh: image-pixel positions of the setup shape, x, y per vertex (3..2048 vertices). Clipping: the clip polygon (3..256 points, simple, concave allowed) in the slot bone's space (through x..scaleY).

end.description: Clipping (plugin 1.12.0): the last slot (draw order, inclusive) the polygon clips; must come after the clipping slot.

sequence.description: Image sequence (plugin 1.12.0): frames of one size drawn with this attachment's placement (imageAssetId = frames[0]); slot sequence keys pick the frame, setupIndex without keys. atlas: written by the export packer, one region (or null) per frame.

uvs.description: Mesh: texture coordinates 0..1, u, v per vertex.

hull.description: Mesh, editor only: the first `hull` vertices are the outline polygon in order (re-triangulation source, plugin 1.6.0).

edges.description: Mesh, editor only: index pairs of the outline edges and of internal edges the author pinned (kept by re-triangulation, plugin 1.6.0).

atlas.description: Written by the export packer (plugin 1.9.0), never by authoring: the picture is the sub-image (x, y, width, height; page pixels) of image asset `page`. `trim` (regions only): the rectangle of the attachment image that sub-image shows (the rest was transparent). Semantics in docs/contract.md.

weights.description: Weighted mesh: per vertex 1..4 bone shares (normalized to sum 1); the bind pose is the setup pose. Absent = the mesh follows the slot bone.
